thought.text: Konten pricing-nya di-render JS. Saya buka pakai browser.

reasoning_content:
Let me open the pricing page in browser to read the actual rendered content (it's client-rendered). Use playwright headless to get text.

Let me do that — one browser session, headless to save memory.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && timeout 280 python3 - <<'PY' 2>&1 | tail -45
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b=p.chromium.launch(headless=True,args=["--no-sandbox"])
    pg=b.new_page(viewport={"width":1280,"height":900})
    pg.goto("https://lebrel.ai/pricing",wait_until="networkidle",timeout=90000)
    pg.wait_for_timeout(4000)
    t=pg.inner_text("body")
    import re
    t=re.sub(r'\n{2,}','\n',t)
    print(t[:2500])
    b.close()
PY
